## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · seat `domain:ui#1` · 2026-10-26T10:11Z

Head `fdb944f6bea0` (read from the PR object).

- **Shape.** Draft on `main`; `Fixes #25887`; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; changeset `.changeset/25887-replayed-build-result-card.md` in the root `.changeset/` (patch, plugin-chatbot + app-shell). The file surface matches the claim and its amendment (comment 6412525647): `mapMessages.ts`, `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, `useChatConversation.ts`, `AiChatPage.tsx`, and two new tests.
- **Checks pinned to the head.** 54 named check runs, latest per name: 46 success, 8 skipped, 0 failing, 0 pending. Test UI 16/16, Type Check UI, Lint UI and Build & E2E UI all succeed.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 26037`: 0 of 7 paths are governed. 363 changed lines, under the human-merge threshold.
- **Fix at the reader, as measured.** A matched replay suppresses the draft review again, with one exception: a `drafted` whole-app build (`detectBuiltAppPackage`), which has no confirm card. `replayedBuildReview` and the hydrated mapper in `AiChatPage.tsx` keep the same rule, so live and reload agree. A failed publish and a `kind: 'edit'` replay keep the objectui#5695 suppression, so no live Publish button appears over a rollback. An auto-publish `published` envelope feeds the build tree and the result card's next steps through `detectPublishedBuildReview`, never an invocation's `draftReview`. The cache keeps the build's draft envelope rather than the bare replay verdict. Each changeset sentence matches the code.
- **sdui record.** Unchanged: `app-shell` and `plugin-chatbot` sit outside the registry closure, so this PR does not join the manifest-hash serial queue.
- **Serial note.** #25908 (back in triage, waiting on the cloud producer) shares `useChatConversation.ts` and `mapMessages.ts`. It lands after this one.

Landing: ready + auto-merge through the relay.
